stem: Glacial striations in the bedrock of South Africa indicate that glaciers once moved across the African continent. The presence of glaciers on the surface of Africa is evidence that —

options.label: F
options.text: the tectonic plate under Africa was closer to the South Pole at one time

options.label: G
options.text: the equator was not always where it is currently located

options.label: H
options.text: volcanoes did not exist until after faults occurred in Earth’s crust

options.label: J
options.text: the location of the North Pole and the South Pole changed

visual_elements: photo of scratched bedrock showing glacial striations
notes: The problem references glacial striations and asks for the evidence from glaciers on African continent related to Earth's geography.
